note: Banked corpus: 6 of 8 usable. sF9h0Bj_48M is the key source - a review that explicitly covers the 1.20.1 revival ('now available for 1.20.1'); Pi5aNpMfBM0 (1.4.6/1.4.7), mzyQsdKQthI + BmxaZniQZDs (1.7.10) and 7DMyf4Zy7LU (jar-era) teach the same mechanics on old versions - facts cross-checked against the 1.20.1 jar ids. jqTg_FZyYdk and wGQMoz12cHA failed to transcribe (0 chars). Jar chococraft-1.20.1-forge-0.9.12.

entry: Entry is a PLANT, not a machine: find wild chococraft:gysahl_green - carrot-like plants scattered everywhere in clusters. Every guide starts here because the green both tames chocobos and seeds a farm (one green crafts into chococraft:gysahl_green_seeds; harvesting gives greens back plus mutation chances).

First tame: feed gysahl greens to a wild yellow chocobo until hearts and a neck band appear (may take several greens). Then chococraft:chocobo_saddle (2 string + 1 leather + 1 chocobo_feather) to ride.

chococraft:chocobo_feather is the mod's universal crafting currency and drops FREE - chocobos molt them on the ground constantly, no killing needed. They also substitute for vanilla feathers in recipes.
chococraft:chocopedia (book + 4 feathers + 2 ink sacs + lapis + gold nugget) is the in-game manual and the pet UI: rename, stay/follow/wander, drop gear.
boss_order: No bosses. The ladder is a BREEDING tree, not a fight ladder.
order: 1. Gysahl farm first: planted greens yield ~15% chococraft:loverly_gysahl_green and ~5% chococraft:gold_gysahl mutations on harvest - both are gates further up the tree, so the farm precedes everything.
2. Tame two yellows (wild chocobos are always yellow) and saddle one.
3. Breed with chococraft:loverly_gysahl_green (the breeding food - one to each parent): yellow+yellow can give GREEN (climbs without jumping) or BLUE (swims fast, floats on water).
4. green+blue -> WHITE (both abilities, faster). white+yellow -> BLACK (faster still, jumps higher; one guide adds night vision while ridden).
5. white+black -> GOLD, and this cross requires chococraft:gold_gysahl - the 5% farm mutation is the hard currency of the endgame. Gold chocobos FLY (hold jump to rise) and take no fall damage.
6. Two golds fed gold gysahls breed true. Optional: right-click a gold with chococraft:red_gysahl / chococraft:pink_gysahl (gysahl + red/pink dye) to recolor it - same abilities.

7. The Nether shortcut: purple chocobos spawn only in the Nether, fly, walk lava and shrug off fire - tamed the same way, an alternative to breeding all the way to gold (guides note gold still flies better).

8. Cargo upgrades along the way: chococraft:chocobo_saddle (no inventory) -> chococraft:chocobo_saddle_bags (small chest, rideable) -> chococraft:chocobo_saddle_pack (big inventory but NOT rideable - a pack animal you lead).

9. Support kit: chococraft:straw (2 wheat) floor around a water-filled cauldron makes a pen that passively HEALS chocobos; chococraft:gysahl_cake instantly grows a chick (tame it first); chococraft:chocobo_whistle (gold ingot + feather) cycles/clears commands.
gates: HARD GATE on gold chocobos: the white+black cross only works with chococraft:gold_gysahl, and gold gysahls only appear as a ~5% harvest mutation from a player-planted farm - flight is gated on farming patience.
Breeding at all is gated on chococraft:loverly_gysahl_green (~15% mutation) - regular greens tame but do not breed.
Purple (Nether) chocobos are gated on a Nether trip and on carrying greens in, since no gysahls grow there.
The mid colors cannot be skipped: yellow -> green+blue -> white -> black -> gold is a fixed tree; one guide tried to jump straight to white and the book says no.
traps: Wild chocobos flee when approached; the chococraft:choco_disguise_helmet set (armor from feathers, roughly iron/diamond-class) exists exactly for this - guides call it hunting gear. Without it early taming is a chase.
The gysahl cake is skippable - guides call growth fast enough to wait out; do not build a quest around the cake as if it were mandatory.
The saddle PACK looks like the upgrade but removes ridability - players who apply it to their mount just lost their mount.
Old guides (1.2.5-1.7.10) show the whistle as an UNTAME tool - on modern builds it manages commands; either way it is not a summon despite the name.
Killing chocobos for chococraft:chocobo_drumstick_raw works but is a trap for tamers - feathers molt for free and dead birds breed nothing.
signature: chococraft:gysahl_green - the taming plant the whole mod stands on.
chococraft:gold_gysahl and chococraft:loverly_gysahl_green - the two farm mutations that gate breeding and flight.
chococraft:chocopedia - manual plus pet control UI.
chococraft:straw pen around a water cauldron - the healing stable.
chococraft:choco_disguise_chestplate - dress as a chocobo to walk among them.
chococraft:flame_chocobo_spawn_egg exists in the 1.20.1 jar but NO guide covers the flame variant - jar-only knowledge, do not invent behavior for it.
